5149.title: Empty catalog persistence and query recovery
5149.rootCauseOneLine: Empty successful catalogs are persisted, but an enabled fresh query re-fetches and recovers; the permanent desktop lock remains unexplained.
5149.proposedFix: Capture the desktop query's enabled state and provider route in an isolated reproduction before changing cache or routing policy.
5149.caveats: Two clean hook-level runs confirm persistence and successful recovery, not the original macOS/Electron incident. Reproduction patch and output are inline in the report. No failing-before-fix regression exists for the permanent lock.
